text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Tuesday, July, 24, 2018 Posted by admin on July 24th, 2018
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +91 points.
Monday the Dow was down -13.83 -(0.06%) at 25,044.29.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +1.32%.
There were 13 Dow stocks up Monday.
The Dow stock winners Monday were led by JPMorgan (JPM) +1.86% and Microsoft (MSFT) +1.60%.
The Dow stock losers Monday were led by 3M (MMM) -1.54% and Chevron (CVX) -0.77%.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended mostly higher.
The national average price of gasoline is down two-tenths of a cent at $2.839 per gallon.
